# Deepal SDK

> Async Python SDK for the Changan Deepal connected-vehicle platforms: the international My Changan gateway (REST, MQTT and signed remote commands) and the SDA platform (China).

Start with the README for installation and a runnable quickstart. Each guide is a step-by-step walkthrough for one developer task; each reference is the exhaustive protocol contract the guides link into.

## Overview

- [Overview and quickstart](README.md): installation, quickstarts and the documentation index

## Guides

- [Authentication](docs/guides/authentication.md): login flows, session persistence and restore, refresh and logout
- [Telemetry](docs/guides/telemetry.md): vehicles, condition, capabilities, digital key and REST/MQTT routing
- [Remote commands](docs/guides/remote-commands.md): control PIN and token, signing, every command family and result polling
- [MQTT telemetry](docs/guides/mqtt-telemetry.md): when MQTT applies and the single-use condition exchange
- [Errors and diagnostics](docs/guides/errors-and-diagnostics.md): exception taxonomy in practice and redacted API logging

## Reference

- [International platform API](docs/reference/intl-api.md): gateways, authentication, telemetry, commands, errors
- [SDA (China) platform API](docs/reference/sda-api.md): access-token client and its limitations
- [MQTT telemetry protocol](docs/reference/mqtt-telemetry.md): bootstrap, connection options, exchange and parameter mapping
- [Data models](docs/reference/models.md): every exported Pydantic model with its fields and unknown semantics

## Optional

- [Full documentation, one file](llms-full.txt): the README, guides and references concatenated verbatim
- [Runnable examples](examples/): login, telemetry and digital-key scripts
